hints.tr: `hostname` adres yoksa `None` verir; `or ""` ile boş metne çevir.
hints.en: `hostname` gives `None` when there is none; turn it into empty text with `or ""`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def hostname_of(url):
    return urlsplit(url).hostname or ""

for url in ["https://login.school.example/reset", "https://school.example@evil.test/x",
            "http://files.example:8443/a", "HTTPS://Login.School.Example/"]:
    print(hostname_of(url))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def hostname_of(url):
    return urlsplit(url).hostname or ""

for url in ["https://login.school.example/reset", "https://school.example@evil.test/x",
            "http://files.example:8443/a", "HTTPS://Login.School.Example/"]:
    print(hostname_of(url))
```
